descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Industria prelucrătoare
Job Overview: 
Represents the client's interests in the organization, ensuring the implementation of its requirements in the processes used and in the delivered products;
Ensures the introduction and compliance in the organization of requirements in accordance with the IATF 16949 standard.
 Responsibilities of a Snr. Qualitiy Manager: 
Representing the client's interests
Assuring the quality of the supplied product
Coordination of laboratory activities
Quality of internal processes
Planning and execution of investment budgets
Management of subordinate human resources
 Snr. Qualitu Manager qualifications: 
Higher technical education
Master in similar fields is an advantage
Minimum 5 years of experience in the automotive industry
Minimum 4 years of experience in quality management
Knowledge of lean manufacturing, 6Sigma, Blackbelt/Lean Expert is an advantage
ISO 9001, IATF 16949, VDA 6.3 requirements/Internal auditor, according to ISO 19011
Knowledge of Core Tools (APQP, PPAP, MSA, CP, FMEA - risk analysis)
Geometric dimensions and tolerances, technical drawing
Very good knowledge of English. Knowledge of a second European language is good to have.
